title: The Pearl in the Sea and the Soul Rising
description: T81 describes how precious truths are formed in the natural mind: pearls arise where particular receptivity has been prepared; from above, the Lord sends down influx like rain, drop after drop into a fitted vessel, where the drops are slowly molded into something formed and lasting. The soul wearing a body is settled or disturbed by what enters her — when bitterness comes in through food and drink, the disordered states circle round and shake her good things from their settled place; when what enters is firm and select, her counsels stand established. T82 tells how the soul in trial finds rest only in the Lord's illumining truth and its receptive form. None of the powers of the natural will open to her — they have been her defilers — but only the sun and moon open the gate. By correspondence, at the end the inmost state where the Lord dwells becomes her final receiver, where she reigns with the luminaries forever.
